added.summary: The default theme names the steps the engine's components were writing by hand, so a class reads `text-title` where it wrote `text-[1.714rem]`. Type: `text-2xs` (11 px, the smallest label) and `text-title` (24 px, a menu row or a HUD's leading figure). Tracking: `tracking-label` (0.14em, a HUD label's capitals), `tracking-kicker` (0.18em) and `tracking-tight` (-0.01em). Leading: `leading-loose` (1.6). Shadows: `shadow-glow-sm`, `shadow-glow` and `shadow-glow-lg` (the HUD accent's light, or another role's with a colour class: `shadow-glow shadow-gold`), `shadow-key` (a key cap's foot), and inside a face `inset-shadow-lit`, `inset-shadow-lip`, `inset-shadow-sunk`, `inset-shadow-glow`, `inset-shadow-underline`, `inset-shadow-overline` and `inset-shadow-bar` (the last four coloured the same way: `inset-shadow-bar inset-shadow-danger`). Inks on the HUD's fills: `fever-fg` and `chart-easy-fg` to `chart-master-fg`.

fixed.summary: Three inks hold 4.5:1 on their grounds where they did not: `foe-fg` on `foe` (it read 3.1:1), `gold-fg` on `gold` in the light scheme (2.9:1), and the `common` rarity colour as a name's ink on a panel (1.7:1; it was a border colour and is now the muted ink).
